verdicts.reason: A keeps both words, but the hero 'MERRY' wordmark is shrunk to an illegible sliver jammed into a cramped cluster of monster icons. That inverts the original hierarchy, so the banner reads 'DISCOUNT MERRY', and there is a dead empty strip at the far left. B arranges the banner more cleanly (art cluster on the left, 'DISCOUNT' on the right) but drops the 'MERRY' wordmark entirely and crams the characters into an unreadable jumble, losing the headline and the festive message.
